Hemo Organic Ltd trades at an extreme valuation of 61.05x price-to-book on a nominal book value of just ₹ 0.38, while the stock sits near the top of its 52-week range at 93% of its span [E1, E4]. This aggressive pricing is entirely divorced from fundamental reality, underscored by a negative price-to-earnings ratio of -9.48x compared to a sector benchmark of 20.32x [E5]. Operational destruction is profound, demonstrated by a catastrophic return on equity of -585.48% against a healthy sector benchmark of 4.67%, alongside a deeply negative return on assets of -17.26% [E7, E8]. Furthermore, any historical top-line momentum has collapsed dramatically into the trailing twelve months with a severe sales contraction of -61% [E14]. Speculative momentum has completely decoupled from business delivery, highlighted by a scanX signal showing price growth outstripping profit growth by an astonishing 912% [E41]. Conceded: the company demonstrates strong multi-year compounded sales growth of 148% over 5 years and 24% over 10 years, alongside positive screen reasons for year-over-year profit growth and accelerating earnings [E12, E13, E50, E52].

Conceded: [E1] and [E4] show a 61.05x price-to-book ratio and a stock sitting at 93% of its 52-week range. However, the data provider reports a contrasting P/B of 0x against a sector benchmark of 1.54x [E6], pointing to a significant valuation mismeasurement in the conventional metric. Conceded: [E5] shows a negative P/E of -9.48x, and [E7], [E8], and [E14] reflect negative returns and a recent -61% twelve-month sales contraction. Yet these lagging indicators obscure the structural multi-year growth engine, proven by a 10-year compounded sales growth of 24% and an explosive 5-year compounded sales growth of 148% [E12, E13]. Furthermore, this long-term expansion is actively outperforming the sector median sales growth of 11.8% [E58]. Conceded: the 5-year compounded sales growth reached 148% [E13] and 10-year compounded sales growth is 24% [E12], alongside screen signals for year-over-year profit growth above 20% and accelerating earnings [E50, E52]. However, the bull's attempt to dismiss the 61.05x price-to-book ratio [E1] by pointing to a conflicting 0x metric [E6] ignores that the company's underlying fundamentals are profoundly destructive, as evidenced by a catastrophic ROE of -585.48% compared to a positive sector benchmark of 4.67% [E8]. Furthermore, the bull's focus on past multi-year sales expansion obscures the acute reality of a -61% twelve-month sales contraction [E14] that completely undermines the sustainability of recent price momentum. This staggering collapse in trailing sales directly validates the signal that price growth exceeds profit growth by a massive 912% [E41], proving that speculative expectations have completely detached from business delivery. Finally, the negative ROA of -17.26% [E7] and negative P/E of -9.48x [E5] confirm that the business is actively burning capital rather than generating the returns necessary to justify a stock sitting at 93% of its 52-week range [E4].
